text:
The evidence does not establish whether the 2023 tree removal was authorized. That would require checking relevant permits or other authorization records.

Satellite data detected 0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2023. The 2021 national forest map classified 0.4 hectares of that area as planted eucalyptus and 0.3 hectares as outside mapped forest; none was mapped as native forest. These classifications do not determine whether removal was permitted.
